scope.included: Public repositories owned by frangelbarrera, excluding the profile index repository itself.
scope.fork_policy: Forks created for pull requests are excluded. The wstg fork is included as the sole explicitly allowed exception because it is the maintained Spanish translation project.
scope.claims_policy: Descriptions are limited to repository metadata and README-supported facts. Maturity is not_assessed unless the repository explicitly identifies a research, curated, translation, prototype, or early-stage role.

taxonomy.ai_agents_and_agent_infrastructure: Agent runtimes, orchestration, control planes, and MCP infrastructure.
taxonomy.osint_and_threat_intelligence: Open-source intelligence, investigation, and cyber-threat-intelligence projects.
taxonomy.network_and_infrastructure_security: Network, cloud, Windows, and infrastructure security tools.
taxonomy.ics_ot_and_scada_security: Industrial control systems, OT, SCADA, and related security work.
taxonomy.application_and_ai_security: Application security, AI security, phishing defense, and code-security tooling.
taxonomy.malware_and_binary_analysis: Malware analysis, reverse engineering, and defensive research.
taxonomy.software_and_product_prototypes: Application prototypes and reusable software foundations.
taxonomy.cloud_and_infrastructure_security: Cloud, Windows, and infrastructure security tools.

entries.name: Abster-Intelligence
entries.summary: Local-first OSINT platform for investigators, presented by the repository as open-source and privacy-centric.
entries.caveat: Capabilities and production readiness were not independently benchmarked.

entries.name: aegistrace-threat-intelligence
entries.summary: Python CTI pipeline that collects and enriches IoCs from five feeds, produces Plotly and CSV outputs, and forecasts seven-day threat trends.
entries.caveat: Forecasts and feed quality require independent validation.

entries.name: agentic-harness
entries.summary: Python agent harness for auditable, cost-controlled LLM workflows using YAML playbooks and MCP server support.
entries.caveat: Not represented as production-ready without an independent operational review.

entries.name: Artificial-Intelligence-Universe
entries.summary: Curated directory of AI tools, agents, LLMs, MCP servers, and learning resources.
entries.caveat: Entries are curated references; inclusion is not an endorsement.

entries.name: awesome-ai-agents
entries.summary: Curated list of AI agent frameworks, coding and automation agents, MCP servers, and evaluation tools.
entries.caveat: Entries are curated references; project status belongs to each linked project.

entries.name: Awesome-Hacking-with-AI
entries.summary: Curated guide to AI-powered offensive security, red-team operations, prompt injection, and adversarial AI research.
entries.caveat: The guide is for lawful, authorized research; inclusion is not an endorsement.

entries.name: Cloud-Misconfig-Scanner
entries.summary: Python CLI for detecting AWS S3 storage misconfigurations; Azure Blob and GCP Storage are described as roadmap items.
entries.caveat: Do not infer Azure or GCP support from the roadmap.

entries.name: code-review-agent-mcp
entries.summary: MCP server for AI-assisted code review, including bug detection and OWASP Top 10 security checks, with configurable harshness.
entries.caveat: Review findings require human validation; no claim of complete vulnerability detection is made.

entries.name: DidILeak
entries.summary: Local-first scanner for detecting leaked API keys, PII, and credentials in selected LLM chat histories, with an HTML dashboard and rotation guidance.
entries.caveat: Detection coverage depends on supported export formats and patterns.

entries.name: ICS-Cybersecurity-Audit
entries.summary: Framework for industrial ICS/OT and SCADA cybersecurity audits covering PLC, Modbus, IEC 62443, and NIST 800-82 references.
entries.caveat: It is not represented as proof of regulatory or functional-safety compliance.

entries.name: industrial-scanner
entries.summary: ICS/OT scanner for passive PCAP analysis and safe read-only Modbus scans, with JSON and HTML reporting.
entries.caveat: Read-only and safe-use claims should be validated against the current implementation and deployment context.

entries.name: Ling-3-flash-evaluation
entries.summary: Independent public evaluation of Ant Group Ling-3.0-flash across 12 documented test phases.
entries.caveat: Evaluation results are specific to the documented methodology and should not be treated as universal model rankings.

entries.name: medical-saas-fullstack-boilerplate
entries.summary: Full-stack medical SaaS MVP boilerplate with AI scribe, role-based security, and PostgreSQL.
entries.caveat: A boilerplate is not a validated medical device or compliant healthcare deployment.

entries.name: Network-Scanner
entries.summary: AI-assisted network reconnaissance and security assessment toolkit with nmap, Python, Flask, React, CLI, web UI, API, and PDF reports.
entries.caveat: Use only on authorized networks; assessment results require analyst review.

entries.name: osint-agent-skills
entries.summary: OSINT knowledge base and MCP server for autonomous-agent workflows, including recon and threat-intelligence playbooks.
entries.caveat: Playbooks are informational tooling and do not guarantee investigative accuracy.

entries.name: OSINT-BIBLE
entries.summary: OSINT compilation covering tools, procedures, methodologies, and ethics for lawful investigation and threat intelligence.
entries.caveat: References may change; users must verify legality, availability, and current behavior.

entries.name: phishing-detection-rnn-cnn
entries.summary: Offline phishing-URL classifier with Flask UI and CLI, trained on lexical URL features and accompanied by a reproducible training pipeline and model artifacts.
entries.caveat: Lexical-only classification is not a complete phishing verdict or a substitute for analyst review.

entries.name: secure-agent-orchestrator
entries.summary: FastAPI control plane for registering security agents and their command tasks. The repository explicitly describes it as early-stage and not production-hardened.
entries.caveat: The repository explicitly says it is not a SOAR and not production-hardened.

entries.name: Spyglass-malware-analysis
entries.summary: Malware-analysis and behavioral-monitoring platform with Frida instrumentation, PE static analysis, DNS-spoofing honeypot, and a web dashboard.
entries.caveat: Use in isolated lab environments and validate behavior before handling live samples.

entries.name: StyxLoaderX-Injection-Research
entries.summary: Academic Windows x64 process-injection research framework covering direct syscalls, AES-256 obfuscation, and sandbox checks.
entries.caveat: The repository is explicitly educational research only; use must be authorized and defensive.

entries.name: trash-tests
entries.summary: Test-effectiveness analyzer for JavaScript and TypeScript that detects no-assertion and trivial-assertion tests and can produce suite scores and PR reviews.
entries.caveat: Scores are signals for review, not a complete measure of test quality.

entries.name: WinSecureAuditor
entries.summary: Python CIS Benchmark auditor for Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server with HTML and JSON compliance reports.
entries.caveat: Audit output is not a certification and should be interpreted with the applicable benchmark version.

entries.name: wstg
entries.summary: Community-maintained Spanish translation of the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide.
entries.caveat: This is a fork relationship; it is included because it is the relevant maintained translation project.
entries.relationship: fork maintained as a Spanish translation of OWASP WSTG
